genxml.title: Pixel-DMA request the IRIX kernel builds for the O2 renderer
genxml.from: shipped IRIX O2 graphics objects, per software/video/crime.md
genxml.doc: Software table, not a register map: the size of the kernel's pixel-DMA request, how long it polls for idle and the ioctl request number that carries it. The CRIME registers it drives are described in the crime repository.
